title_en: Triage Public Hornet Reports under Sparse Verification
title_zh: 稀少验证下的公众大黄蜂报告分流
identity_zh: 固定自主周期终稿，包含一轮科学反馈；封存后同题学习之前的版本。
identity_en: Final manuscript from a fixed autonomous cycle, including one scientific feedback round, sealed before same-task reference learning.
assessment_zh: 同一作者外 AI 对当前 19 页完整修订稿复核，Finalist 中心、Meritorious–Finalist 相邻；未校准，未建立 O 竞争力。
assessment_en: The same author-external AI revisited the complete corrected 19-page manuscript: Finalist-centered, adjacent Meritorious–Finalist; uncalibrated, with O competitiveness not established.
strength_zh: 区分生物传播、报告分类和监测检出；按文本、位置和日期建立调查队列，保留时序表现下降、验证选择与概率迁移反例。
strength_en: Separates biological spread, report classification and surveillance detection. Builds a text/location/date investigation queue while retaining temporal performance decline, verification selection and probability-transport counterexamples.
limits_zh: 仅 14 条阳性且存在重复局地记录；标签可用时间、验证机制、未定报告真值与跨地区迁移未知。图像像素未取得，不是图像识别；修订未提高原预测器点表现。缺实测检出率，不能证明灭绝。
limits_en: Only 14 positives, with repeated local records. Label timing, verification mechanisms, unresolved truth and geographic transport remain unknown. Image pixels were not acquired: this is not image recognition, and the correction did not improve point prediction performance. No measured surveillance sensitivity or eradication conclusion.
review_scope_zh: 当前全部 19 页、三图六表与两页机构备忘录；指定代数、2357 条队列和 2000 次重采样独立核对，并接续不变的原数值证据；同一评阅者，不是新盲评。
review_scope_en: All 19 current pages, three figures, six tables and the two-page memorandum; targeted independent algebra, 2357-record queue and 2000-resample audits with reuse of unchanged numerical evidence. Same reviewer, not a fresh blind assessment.
reviewer_identity_zh: 作者外 AI 评阅，同一评阅者复核；非真人或技术盲审。确切实际模型身份未知。
reviewer_identity_en: Author-external AI review with follow-up by the same reviewer; neither human nor technically blind. Exact served model identity is unknown.
